thread:
Alex T.: Heads-up — CloudBridge wants SEA-EAST-2 on our marketplace next quarter, asking for 4xA100 capacity + KMS integration. Need quota and entitlement flow. Anyone tracking?
Maria G.: tagging @Sanjay @Jia — they want reserved capacity + marketplace listing. Do we have precheck doc for partners launching region SKUs?
Jia L.: we need to validate model-serving SKUs. 4x A100 is fine but recommend 8x for burst. Also check GPU driver compatibility and CUDA runtime pinned in their image.
Sanjay P.: noted. I'll open infra ticket to request quota in SEA-EAST-2 and start network peering checklist. Can someone confirm the project/org IDs we should request against?
Alyssa (CloudBridge): hey! our billing org is cloudbridge-prod-567. We can provide image manifest and KMS key ARN once legal signs. ETA for go-live is ~6 weeks.
Katherine R.: on legal — we need an updated DPA for cross-region keys and customer-managed KMS. I'll draft and loop Alyssa. Also: export controls check for GPUs? Confirmed internal checklist needed.
Maria G.: action list: 1) infra quota ticket, 2) KMS access flow + key ARN, 3) marketplace entitlement request, 4) legal DPA + SLA items. I'll own #3 and coordinate announcement with marketing.
ops-bot: Quota request created: Q-2026-3495 for SEA-EAST-2 (assigned to @Sanjay P.). Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/Q-2026-3495
Sanjay P.: opened PRD and ticket. Using template:
```
project: redwood-partners
region: sea-east-2
requested_skus: A100-40GB x4
purpose: CloudBridge marketplace reserved pool
```
Jia L.: also recommend enabling prefix KV cache on those nodes — share perf delta once we have traffic profile. If they plan longer contexts, mention higher mem SKUs.
Alyssa (CloudBridge): we'll provide traffic profile next week. KMS: need guidance on key rotation and least-privileged IAM role for encrypt/decrypt.
Katherine R.: standard recommended policy attached in thread (I'll email). We require key rotation window <= 90 days for marketplace entitlements.
Maria G.: marketing ask — do we want partner joint blog at launch? If yes, need 2-week buffer before go-live for assets and approval.
Alex T.: yes to joint blog. Also propose staged rollout: start with dedicated pilot (2 customers), ramp to marketplace GA after SLA metrics stable.
Sanjay P.: timeline: quota ticket -> 3 business days for approval -> infra provisioning 5 days -> partner validation 7 days. So ~15 business days post-approval.
Alyssa (CloudBridge): sounds good. We'll prep images and provide test keys by EOW.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: partner-pilot/sea-east-2 on 1991239800
Maria G.: Great progress. I'll book weekly sync with Alyssa and send calendar invites. Owners: infra=@Sanjay P., legal=@Katherine R., partner=@Maria G., eng-ml=@Jia L.
Alex T.: thanks everyone — please add any blockers in the ticket Q-2026-3495. :thumbsup:
